atoms.text: Helena opened the fridge to try and find an apple. In the fridge, she found an apple that had turned brown. The apple also had a bad smell and had grown mould.

atoms.a: What has happened to the apple?

atoms.text: Robert’s mum told him to try the spaghetti. Robert took a big mouthful of the spaghetti, he frowned and then spat it back onto the plate.

atoms.a: How did Robert feel about the spaghetti?
Which phrase suggests that Robert did not like the spaghetti?

atoms.text: Linus reached into the cupboard to get himself a glass. As he reached in, he accidentally knocked a glass to the floor. The glass hit the ground and shattered into lots of little pieces. Linus carefully cleaned up the glass.

atoms.a: Which phrase suggests that the glass broke?

atoms.text: Carlos works in a coffee shop. He has been working there for about two years. He works there part-time because he is currently studying at university. He has worked hard to learn how to do latte art.

atoms.a: Has Carlos made an effort to learn how to do latte art?
Which phrase suggests that he made an effort to learn how to do latte art?
